summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved plan: AWF self-profile declares an explicit 99% local final coverage gate with profile-driven parallel_workers while targeted edit validation remains coverage-free; runtime coverage handling preserves xdist FAILED/ERROR pytest evidence, including class-style parametrized node IDs, and classifies coverage-at-threshold plus pytest nonzero as PYTEST_TEST_FAILURE; executor helpers preserve validation_failure classification, failure messages, coverage metadata, and local final-gate command records without changing GitHub Actions semantics. No serial grouping or hidden skips were added. Existing validation artifacts report focused regression suites, ruff, and mypy passing; the prior full local xdist stress run had no pytest failures/errors/timeouts after fixes but stayed below 99% because Docker-backed integration tests skipped in this Docker-unavailable workspace, with GitHub Actions documented as the authoritative full coverage gate.
